visualCalibration.manufacturerCaption: A front view of a 13.8-inch Surface Laptop in the color Platinum.
visualCalibration.method: Pixels of the linked PNG at wid=1600. Bounds use alpha > 230 to suppress soft shadow; [left, top, right, bottom) in image coordinates. Interior landmarks are approximate RGB transitions, not CAD dimensions.
visualCalibration.observations: Rounded lid and active corners; the bottom black bezel is deeper than the top. A centered lens and faint adjacent apertures sit above the screen. The dark hinge line is low and continuous; no exposed barrels. The deck flares toward a thin silver lip, with the keyboard and touchpad visible above it.
visualCalibration.mapping: Use the measured relative widths and bezel offsets. Omit the projected keyboard surface (roughly rows 918–999) for the catalog front elevation; model only the lip and underside, not an 82 px thick slab. The result is intentionally shorter than the photographed silhouette. No physical base thickness is inferred.
visualCalibration.estimates: The hinge is the small gap between lid and deck filled by the renderer. Corner radii, lens radius, underside curvature and exact seam boundaries are illustrative; the single lens simplifies the sensor cluster.

visualCalibration.manufacturerCaption: View forward-facing DX13260 Roma Dell XPS 13 Laptop Sky Configuration
visualCalibration.method: Pixels of the linked PNG at wid=1600. Bounds use alpha > 230 to suppress soft shadow; [left, top, right, bottom) in image coordinates. Interior landmarks are approximate RGB transitions, not CAD dimensions.
visualCalibration.observations: Nearly level view: the base projects symmetrically past the lid. No keyboard surface is visible. A broad shallow recess interrupts the silver front lip above its rounded underside. The slim side bezels widen at the chin; a faint camera/sensor cluster lies inside the uninterrupted top bezel. There are no visible hinge barrels.
visualCalibration.mapping: Use gallery 11, not the elevated gallery 1 keyboard view. Scale horizontal spans to the existing active width; fit the native 16:10 aperture and retain the measured top bezel, chin and base strip. The near-level silhouette is preserved.
visualCalibration.estimates: The hinge is the small gap between lid and deck filled by the renderer. Corner radii, lens radius, underside curvature and exact seam boundaries are illustrative; the single lens simplifies the sensor cluster.
